'''Osleo Prennert''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] and sentry served the Rebels on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Prennert was on duty at [[Recon-tower 4|recon-tower four]] when the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millenium Falcon]]'' landed at [[Massassi Site/Legends|Massassi Site]] on the moon.

==Biography==
Osleo Prennert was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]]<ref name="Insider 92">{{InsiderCite|92|Refresher Reading}}</ref> in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]<ref name="CSWE" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ANH" /> The man was assigned the duty of sentry, identifying incoming [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and alerting the Alliance's combat forces of upcoming attacks.<ref name="CSWE" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> Prennert patrolled<ref name="CSWE" /> for the Rebels on<ref name="ANH" /> the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="TEA>''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="ANH" /> The corporal stayed on watch for [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and other hazards of the Rebellion and supplemented data created by the main sensors of<ref name="CCGSentry">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Yavin Sentry}}</ref> the Alliance base at Massassi Site.<ref name="ANH" />

[[File:WhatsTheSpearFor-ANH.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Prennert served the Rebel Alliance on Yavin 4.]]
Shortly after the Rebel [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was rescued from the Empire's [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]],<ref name="ANH" /> Prennert was on duty at [[Recon-tower 4|recon-tower four]] atop a monument north of the Massassi Site.<ref name="Insider 92" /> The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], a starship carrying Organa, [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], arrived at the Rebel's base.<ref name="ANH" /> Prennert visually monitored the ship's atmospheric descent<ref name="JN">*[[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'' junior novelization]]</ref> with<ref name="ANH" /> a hand scanner.<ref name="Insider 92" /> The man later watched the Alliance's [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] taking off to attack the Death Star.<ref name="ANH" />

==Personality and traits==
Prennert was a light-skinned<ref name="ANH" /> man who was loyal to the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Osleo Prennert first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> The character was portrayed by [[Industrial Light & Magic]]<ref name="Lorne Peterson interview" /> modelmaker<ref name="Insider 92" /> [[Lorne Peterson]], who was one of three crew members who went to [[Wikipedia:Tikal|Tikal]], [[Wikipedia:Guatemala|Guatemala]] for filming, alongside [[Richard Edlund]] and [[Dick Alexander]]. Peterson was chosen for the dangerous job of standing on the tower,<ref name="Lorne Peterson interview" /> which was a modified fifty gallon trash can,<ref name="Insider 92" /> because he was the only one who did not have any children.<ref name="Lorne Peterson interview">{{SWYouTube|M7oQHQkNdkA|Steve Gawley and Lorne Peterson Interview with StarWars.com &#124; Star Wars Celebration Anaheim}}</ref> Peterson also improvised the character's scanner prop, which was crafted from a light-meter gaffer with other camera gear added on to it.<ref name="Insider 92" /> The character was first identified with the [[Pablo Hidalgo]] written "[[Refresher Reading]]" section of the [[Star Wars Insider 92|ninty-second]] issue of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'', published on [[February 19]], [[2007]].<ref name="Date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=189387#7516035|thread=Upcoming Release Schedule|user=James T. Skywalker|date=2004-08-12|time=11:44 AM}}</ref>
